item.title: [War on the Rocks] Winning Time: Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces and the New Dimension of War
item.description: In late 2023, Ukraine’s military leadership faced an institutional choice: establish a dedicated branch of the armed forces for unmanned systems or integrate drones into existing branches. Most senior officers I knew opposed the separate force, and their strongest argument was sound within classical doctrine.
